Less manual work. Document preparation, data rooms and due diligence in one place. AI organises your documents, finds what matters and flags risks, for acquisitions, company sales and investments. Book a demo See the AI at work Meet the team, bring a mandate and talk to us about early access. Headquartered in Oslo, Norway Experience behind the platform Technology meets transaction experience. Our team combines product and technology expertise with extensive advisory experience in business acquisitions, sales and international transactions. in transactions advised by the team €1.8B+ of experience in transactions and capital markets 30 years Who it's for Built for the people who run deals. Investors Review opportunities with organised documents, AI-surfaced risks and a clear path to a decision. FROM FIRST FILES TO DECISION Every stage moves faster, on both sides of the deal. Whether you are selling a company or assessing one, Closva's AI takes on the time-consuming steps while your team stays in control of every decision. Selling a company Buying or investing 01 AI prepares the data room Upload the company's files. Closva files them into an indexed data room, reads every document and flags potential red flags, missing documents and follow-up questions, each linked to the page it comes from. Document findings · Project Nord 02 AI drafts the teaser and memorandum Choose the documents and the story. Closva drafts blind teasers and the information memorandum with every claim linked to its source; you review the open points and approve each revision. Project Nord — information memorandum 03 Every buyer sees only what you allow Register each buyer's NDA, admit them personally and decide folder by folder what each buyer group can view or download. Every page they open is watermarked and logged. Data room · Project Nord 04 Answer buyers with reviewed answers Buyer questions land in one place. Ask your team for input, review the answer and publish it to the buyer who asked, or to every group. Q&A · Project Nord AI prepares the deal pack Faster from first files to closing You review. You approve. Learn more: Virtual data room Learn more: AI deal materials Learn more: Buy-side due diligence Due diligence AI spots the red flags before your buyers do. Closva reads the data room the way a diligence team would. It flags risks and missing documents, links every finding to its source and keeps the whole team working from the same picture. Red flags Change-of-control clauses, customer concentration and conflicting figures, each linked to the page or lines it came from. Missing documents AI checks what is in the data room against what buyers will ask for, so you can request the gaps before they hold up the deal. Coordinated teams Findings, open tasks and deadlines sit in one deal workspace, so advisers, the seller's team and specialists work from the same list.
